About Raju Gari Biryani

Welcome to Raju Gari Biryani!

Experience the authentic taste of Hyderabad with our signature biryani, crafted with love and tradition.

Our Story

Founded in 1995, Raju Gari Biryani brings the authentic taste of Hyderabad to your plate. Our recipes, passed down through generations, use secret spices and the traditional dum technique to create unforgettable flavors.

From our humble beginnings as a small eatery to becoming a beloved name in Hyderabad, we remain committed to quality, authenticity, and customer satisfaction.

Our Mission

We aim to deliver not just food, but an experience that celebrates Hyderabad’s rich culinary heritage. Using only the freshest ingredients, we ensure every bite is a journey to the heart of Telangana.

Join us in our passion for biryani and discover why Raju Gari Biryani is a household name!
